Bisleri, one of India's biggest packaged drinking water brands, is facing scrutiny after FSSAI reportedly found excess bromate in a water sample collected from its Goa manufacturing unit. A subsequent test also detected PAHs, chemicals linked to cancer risks. However, Bisleri disputes the findings, claiming an independent laboratory found bromate levels within permissible limits. So, what exactly did FSSAI's tests reveal? How dangerous are bromate and PAHs?
